verdict.rationale: Tone and brand-voice control is a fair axis for an AI customer-support agent. The evidence covers natural-language configuration of flows, policies, knowledge, tools and guardrails, but never mentions tone, brand voice, style guidelines, or multilingual consistency. General configurability is adjacent and does not count as this capability.

support.subject: As a support leader, I control the agent's tone and brand voice, and it stays consistent across topics and languages
